senses.en: to provide someone with something useful or pleasant
senses.pattern: afford a view of / afford an opportunity / afford protection
senses.example: The hilltop tower [[affords]] visitors a wonderful view of the harbor and the islands beyond.
senses.example_zh: 這座山頂的高塔為遊客提供絕佳視野，可眺望港口與遠處的島嶼。

senses.en: to be able to do something without serious problems
senses.pattern: cannot afford to lose / can't afford a mistake / can ill afford to
senses.example: With the final exam only a week away, we cannot [[afford]] to waste any more time.
senses.example_zh: 期末考只剩一週，我們承擔不起再浪費時間的後果。
senses.note: 多用於否定句：cannot afford to V

senses.en: wanting very much to do or have something
senses.pattern: be anxious to do / be anxious for news / be anxious that
senses.example: After a month in the hospital, Grandpa was [[anxious]] to get home and see his garden again.
senses.example_zh: 住院一個月後，爺爺急切地想回家，再看看他的花園。
senses.note: anxious to V／for N 表「渴望」

senses.en: an urgent request for help, money, or information
senses.pattern: make an appeal for / launch an appeal / an appeal to the public
senses.example: After the earthquake, the charity launched an urgent [[appeal]] for blankets, tents, and clean drinking water.
senses.example_zh: 地震過後，這個慈善團體緊急呼籲各界捐贈毛毯、帳篷和乾淨的飲用水。
senses.note: 也作動詞：appeal (to sb) for sth

senses.en: to ask a higher court to change a decision
senses.pattern: appeal against the verdict / appeal to a higher court / the right to appeal
senses.example: The company lost the case, but its lawyers plan to [[appeal]] to a higher court next month.
senses.example_zh: 這家公司敗訴了，但其律師打算下個月向上級法院提出上訴。
senses.note: 名詞同形：file an appeal 提出上訴

gsat.sentence: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an [[appeal]] for the public to donate blood.

senses.en: empty; not covered or decorated with anything
senses.pattern: bare shelves / bare walls / bare trees
senses.example: The walls of his new apartment were [[bare]] until he hung up some family photos.
senses.example_zh: 他新公寓的牆上原本空無一物，後來才掛上幾張家庭照片。

senses.en: the most basic; just enough and no more
senses.pattern: the bare essentials / the bare minimum / the bare necessities
senses.example: The hikers packed only the [[bare]] essentials: water, a map, a flashlight, and some dried food.
senses.example_zh: 登山客只帶了最基本的必需品：水、地圖、手電筒和一些乾糧。
senses.note: 動詞 bare＝露出，如 bare its teeth

gsat.sentence: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost [[bare]] and the stock nearly gone.
But now the garden looked shabby and [[bare]].

senses.en: to feel almost sure that something is true
senses.pattern: I bet (that)… / I'll bet… / you can bet (that)…
senses.example: I [[bet]] the bus will be late again, since it has been raining heavily all morning.
senses.example_zh: 我敢說公車又會誤點，因為整個早上都在下大雨。
senses.note: 口語用法；常用 I bet / I'll bet

senses.en: a choice or action that is likely to succeed
senses.pattern: your best bet / a safe bet / a good bet
senses.example: If you want to avoid the crowds, your best [[bet]] is to visit the museum on a weekday morning.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想避開人潮，最好的辦法就是平日早上去參觀博物館。

senses.en: to express or record a feeling or scene accurately
senses.pattern: capture the spirit of / capture the mood / capture the moment / capture sth on camera
senses.example: The short film perfectly [[captures]] the excitement and nervousness of the first day at a new school.
senses.example_zh: 這部短片完美捕捉了到新學校第一天那種興奮又緊張的心情。

senses.en: to attract and hold someone's interest or attention
senses.pattern: capture the imagination of / capture sb's attention / capture the interest of
senses.example: The story of a dog that waited years for its owner [[captured]] the imagination of readers worldwide.
senses.example_zh: 一隻狗苦等主人多年的故事，深深吸引了全世界的讀者。

senses.en: to succeed in getting a share of something
senses.pattern: capture a share of the market / capture 40% of the vote / capture the title
senses.example: Within two years, the small startup had [[captured]] nearly half of the local market for electric scooters.
senses.example_zh: 短短兩年內，這家小型新創公司就奪得了當地電動機車市場將近一半的市占率。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following sayings best [[captures]] the spirit of Jeanie Low’s story?
Although about 90 percent of American households still use film cameras, digital cameras are [[capturing]] a growing share of the consumer market.

senses.en: done without much care or thought
senses.pattern: a casual remark / a casual glance / a casual attitude toward
senses.example: It was only a [[casual]] remark, but it hurt his feelings more than she had realized.
senses.example_zh: 那只是漫不經心的一句話，卻比她所意識到的更傷他的心。

senses.en: (of work or workers) temporary, not regular
senses.pattern: casual workers / casual labor / a casual job
senses.example: During the harvest season, the farm hires [[casual]] workers who are paid by the day.
senses.example_zh: 採收季期間，農場會雇用按日計酬的臨時工。

senses.en: a tiny piece of silicon holding electronic circuits
senses.pattern: a computer chip / a silicon chip / a chip maker
senses.example: A tiny [[chip]] placed under the dog's skin helps shelters return lost pets to their owners.
senses.example_zh: 植入狗皮下的微小晶片，能幫助收容所把走失的寵物送回飼主身邊。

senses.en: a token used in gambling, or an advantage in bargaining
senses.pattern: a bargaining chip / poker chips / a stack of chips
senses.example: The union used the planned strike as a bargaining [[chip]] to win better pay for its workers.
senses.example_zh: 工會把預定的罷工當作談判籌碼，為勞工爭取更好的薪資。

senses.en: to break a small piece off something hard
senses.pattern: chip a tooth / chip off / a chipped cup
senses.example: Be careful with those plates; the edges [[chip]] easily if you knock them against the sink.
senses.example_zh: 拿那些盤子要小心，邊緣一撞到水槽就很容易碰出缺口。

gsat.sentence: The junk varies from tiny pieces of paint [[chipped]] off rockets to cameras, huge fuel tanks, and even odd items like the million-dollar tool kit that astronaut Heidemarie Stefanyshyn-Piper lost during a spacewalk.

senses.en: staying the same; not changing
senses.pattern: a constant temperature / a constant speed / remain constant
senses.example: The museum's storage room is kept at a [[constant]] temperature of eighteen degrees all year round.
senses.example_zh: 博物館的儲藏室全年維持在十八度的恆定溫度。

senses.en: a number or thing that never changes
senses.pattern: a mathematical constant / a physical constant / the one constant in sb's life
senses.example: In a world of rapid change, my grandmother's kindness has been the one [[constant]] in my life.
senses.example_zh: 在瞬息萬變的世界裡，奶奶的慈愛一直是我生命中唯一不變的事物。

senses.en: (of a computer or system) to suddenly stop working
senses.pattern: the computer crashed / the system crashed / the website keeps crashing
senses.example: My laptop [[crashed]] right before I saved the report, so I had to type everything again.
senses.example_zh: 我的筆電就在我存檔前當機了，所以整份報告都得重打。

senses.en: a sudden large fall in prices or value
senses.pattern: a stock market crash / a financial crash / a crash in house prices
senses.example: Thousands of investors lost their life savings in the stock market [[crash]] of 1929.
senses.example_zh: 數千名投資人在一九二九年的股市崩盤中賠光了畢生積蓄。

senses.en: a bat-and-ball game played by two teams of eleven
senses.pattern: play cricket / a cricket match / a cricket team / a cricket bat
senses.example: In India and Australia, millions of fans stay up late to watch important [[cricket]] matches.
senses.example_zh: 在印度和澳洲，數以百萬計的球迷會熬夜觀看重要的板球比賽。

gsat.sentence: He explained that he had just retired and was happiest when he could see or hear boys playing his favorite game, [[cricket]].
An old man who lived in a small side street of Mumbai had to put up with the nuisance of boys playing [[cricket]] and making a lot of noise outside his house, at night.

senses.en: to find out the facts about something
senses.pattern: determine the cause of / determine whether… / determine the age of
senses.example: Firefighters are still trying to [[determine]] the cause of the fire that destroyed the old theater.
senses.example_zh: 消防人員仍在設法查明燒毀舊戲院那場火災的起因。

senses.en: to be the thing that controls a result
senses.pattern: be determined by / determine the outcome / determine the price
senses.example: The amount of sleep you get largely [[determines]] how well you can concentrate in class.
senses.example_zh: 睡眠時間的多寡，在很大程度上決定了你上課時能有多專心。
senses.note: 主詞為「因素」，非「人做決定」

gsat.sentence: This comparative advantage is [[determined]] by key factors of production such as land, capital, and labor.
Once the questions are finished, the examiner analyzes the results to [[determine]] if the person tested was being truthful.

senses.en: to sell goods abroad at unfairly low prices
senses.pattern: dump goods on the market / dump cheap steel / be accused of dumping
senses.example: Local farmers complained that foreign companies were [[dumping]] cheap rice on the market.
senses.example_zh: 當地農民抱怨外國公司在市場上傾銷廉價的米。

senses.en: to suddenly end a relationship with someone
senses.pattern: dump one's boyfriend / get dumped / dump somebody for someone else
senses.example: He felt terrible after his girlfriend [[dumped]] him by text message just before the holidays.
senses.example_zh: 女友在假期前用簡訊甩掉他，讓他難過極了。

senses.en: to clean something by wiping dust off it
senses.pattern: dust the furniture / dust the shelves / dust off an old book
senses.example: Every Saturday morning, Tom helps his mother [[dust]] the bookshelves and mop the living room floor.
senses.example_zh: 每週六早上，湯姆都會幫媽媽拂去書架上的灰塵，並拖客廳的地板。
senses.note: dust off 也指「重新拿出來用」

senses.en: to cover something lightly with a fine powder
senses.pattern: dust A with B / dust the cake with sugar / lightly dusted with flour
senses.example: The baker [[dusted]] the warm cake with powdered sugar before placing it in the shop window.
senses.example_zh: 麵包師傅把糖粉撒在溫熱的蛋糕上，然後把蛋糕放進櫥窗。

gsat.sentence: One day, she [[dusted]] off the story she had written for the writers’ group and decided to make it into a novel.

senses.en: a short conversation or argument
senses.pattern: a heated exchange / an angry exchange / a brief exchange
senses.example: After a heated [[exchange]] with the referee, the coach was ordered to leave the field.
senses.example_zh: 與裁判激烈爭吵之後，教練被命令離開球場。

senses.en: a place where shares or goods are bought and sold
senses.pattern: the stock exchange / a commodity exchange / trade on an exchange
senses.example: Trading on the stock [[exchange]] was stopped for an hour after prices dropped too quickly.
senses.example_zh: 由於股價跌得太快，證券交易所的交易暫停了一小時。

gsat.sentence: Churchill, however, managed to get the better of this [[exchange]].

senses.en: to appear or move very quickly
senses.pattern: flash through one's mind / flash by / flash past / flash across the screen
senses.example: As the bus pulled away, the thought [[flashed]] through my mind that I had left my wallet on the seat.
senses.example_zh: 公車開走時，我腦中突然閃現一個念頭：我把錢包忘在座位上了。

senses.en: to show something quickly or for a moment
senses.pattern: flash a smile / flash an ID card / flash a look at
senses.example: The officer [[flashed]] his badge at the guard and walked straight into the building.
senses.example_zh: 那名警官向警衛亮出警徽，然後直接走進大樓。
senses.note: 名詞：a flash of inspiration 靈光一現

senses.en: something done to show a feeling or intention
senses.pattern: a gesture of goodwill / a kind gesture / a gesture of support / a symbolic gesture
senses.example: As a [[gesture]] of thanks, the villagers sent baskets of fruit to the rescue team.
senses.example_zh: 村民送了好幾籃水果給救難隊，作為感謝的表示。

senses.en: very serious and worrying; solemn
senses.pattern: grave concerns / grave danger / a grave mistake / a grave expression
senses.example: The long drought has put the region's rice farmers in [[grave]] danger of losing their entire harvest.
senses.example_zh: 長期乾旱使該地區的稻農面臨失去全部收成的嚴重危險。
senses.note: 副詞 gravely；名詞 gravity 嚴重性

gsat.sentence: Deadly shootings on US campuses have raised [[grave]] concerns about how to prevent such tragic incidents from happening again.

senses.en: to keep a feeling or thought in mind for long
senses.pattern: harbor a grudge / harbor doubts / harbor resentment / harbor hopes
senses.example: Although he apologized, she still [[harbored]] doubts about whether he had told the truth.
senses.example_zh: 雖然他道了歉，她仍心懷疑慮，不確定他是否說了實話。

senses.en: to hide and protect someone, especially a criminal
senses.pattern: harbor a criminal / harbor a fugitive / harbor refugees
senses.example: The farmer was arrested for [[harboring]] two escaped prisoners in his barn for a week.
senses.example_zh: 那名農夫因在穀倉窩藏兩名逃犯一週而被捕。

senses.en: knowledge gained through study and reading
senses.pattern: a man of learning / a woman of great learning / book learning
senses.example: The old professor was respected not only for his great [[learning]] but also for his kindness to students.
senses.example_zh: 這位老教授受人敬重，不僅因為他學識淵博，也因為他對學生很親切。
senses.note: 形容詞 learned /ˈlɝnɪd/ 博學的

senses.en: to try to persuade officials to support something
senses.pattern: lobby the government / lobby for a change / lobby against a plan
senses.example: Parents' groups have been [[lobbying]] the city council for safer crossings near schools.
senses.example_zh: 家長團體一直在遊說市議會，要求在學校附近設置更安全的行人穿越道。

senses.en: a group that tries to influence lawmakers
senses.pattern: the environmental lobby / a powerful lobby / the farm lobby
senses.example: The environmental [[lobby]] is pushing for stricter limits on plastic packaging.
senses.example_zh: 環保遊說團體正在推動對塑膠包裝設下更嚴格的限制。

senses.en: a small bunch of hair
senses.pattern: a lock of hair / curly locks / golden locks
senses.example: The mother kept a [[lock]] of her baby's hair in a small silver box.
senses.example_zh: 那位母親把寶寶的一綹頭髮收藏在一個小銀盒裡。

senses.en: to hold someone in a struggle or fixed position
senses.pattern: be locked in a battle / be locked in a dispute / be locked in talks
senses.example: The two companies have been [[locked]] in a legal battle over the patent for three years.
senses.example_zh: 這兩家公司為了這項專利陷入法律纏鬥已有三年。

senses.en: the lesson that a story teaches
senses.pattern: the moral of the story / draw a moral from / a story with a moral
senses.example: The [[moral]] of the fable is that honesty is worth more than gold.
senses.example_zh: 這則寓言的寓意是，誠實比黃金更有價值。
senses.note: 複數 morals 指品行；勿混 morale 士氣

senses.en: psychological rather than practical or physical
senses.pattern: moral support / give sb moral support / a moral victory
senses.example: My best friend came to the speech contest just to give me [[moral]] support.
senses.example_zh: 我最好的朋友來到演講比賽現場，只為了給我精神上的支持。

gsat.sentence: Another [[moral]] which also means a great deal is “competition against situations rather than against rivals.”

senses.en: the power or influence to get things done
senses.pattern: financial muscle / political muscle / economic muscle
senses.example: Small bookstores lack the financial [[muscle]] to compete with giant online retailers on price.
senses.example_zh: 小書店缺乏財務實力，無法和大型網路零售商打價格戰。

senses.en: of the mouth; taken by mouth
senses.pattern: oral health / oral hygiene / oral cancer / oral medication
senses.example: Dentists remind us that good [[oral]] health depends on brushing twice a day and eating less sugar.
senses.example_zh: 牙醫提醒我們，良好的口腔健康有賴於每天刷牙兩次並少吃糖。

senses.en: a spoken examination, especially in a foreign language
senses.pattern: a French oral / take an oral / pass the oral
senses.example: She was so nervous before her French [[oral]] that she could hardly eat breakfast.
senses.example_zh: 她在法文口試前緊張到幾乎吃不下早餐。

senses.en: training given before starting a new school or job
senses.pattern: freshman orientation / an orientation program / orientation week / attend an orientation
senses.example: During [[orientation]], new employees are shown around the office and introduced to their team leaders.
senses.example_zh: 在新進人員訓練期間，會有人帶新員工參觀辦公室，並介紹他們認識組長。

senses.en: the main interests, aims, or beliefs of a person or group
senses.pattern: a practical orientation / a political orientation / a strong customer orientation
senses.example: The course has a practical [[orientation]], with more lab work than lectures.
senses.example_zh: 這門課是實務取向，實驗課比講課還多。

senses.en: a small group chosen to discuss or judge something
senses.pattern: a panel of experts / a panel of judges / a panel discussion / an interview panel
senses.example: A [[panel]] of five judges will choose the winner of the national science fair.
senses.example_zh: 由五位評審組成的評審團將選出全國科展的優勝者。

gsat.sentence: To be qualified as “extra virgin,” the oil must also pass both an official test in a laboratory and a sensory evaluation by a trained tasting [[panel]].

senses.en: to move somewhere quickly in large numbers
senses.pattern: pour into / pour out of / pour in
senses.example: As soon as the gates opened, thousands of excited fans [[poured]] into the stadium for the final.
senses.example_zh: 大門一開，成千上萬名興奮的球迷便湧入體育場觀看決賽。

senses.en: to rain very heavily
senses.pattern: it is pouring / pour down / pour with rain
senses.example: It was [[pouring]] when the game ended, and nobody in our group had brought an umbrella.
senses.example_zh: 比賽結束時正下著傾盆大雨，而我們這群人都沒帶傘。
senses.note: 主詞常用 it，多用進行式

gsat.sentence: Unfortunately, it started [[pouring]].

senses.en: an impressive manner that makes people notice someone
senses.pattern: stage presence / a commanding presence / have great presence
senses.example: Although the singer is only sixteen, her stage [[presence]] holds the attention of every person in the hall.
senses.example_zh: 這位歌手雖然才十六歲，她的舞台風采卻能吸引全場每個人的目光。

senses.en: a person or thing that is present somewhere
senses.pattern: a familiar presence / a calming presence / a constant presence
senses.example: The friendly old guard has been a familiar [[presence]] at the school gate for over twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 這位親切的老警衛二十多年來一直是校門口大家熟悉的身影。

senses.en: a group of soldiers or police stationed in a place
senses.pattern: a police presence / a military presence / a heavy security presence
senses.example: There was a heavy police [[presence]] around the stadium to keep order during the final match.
senses.example_zh: 決賽期間，體育場周圍有大批警力駐守以維持秩序。

gsat.sentence: Whether they wielded rods or pea shooters, knockers-up became familiar [[presences]] throughout the United Kingdom.

senses.en: a special chance that makes you feel honored
senses.pattern: it is a privilege to / have the privilege of / a great privilege / a rare privilege
senses.example: It was a great [[privilege]] to meet the scientist whose books had inspired me since childhood.
senses.example_zh: 能見到那位著作從小啟發我的科學家，真是莫大的榮幸。

gsat.sentence: Ladies and gentlemen, it is my [[privilege]] to speak to you all on this special occasion.

senses.en: to judge the quality or value of something
senses.pattern: be rated as / rate sth highly / rate sth on a scale of one to ten
senses.example: Most viewers [[rated]] the documentary as the best program shown on television this year.
senses.example_zh: 多數觀眾把這部紀錄片評定為今年電視上播出的最佳節目。

senses.en: a fixed amount of money charged for something
senses.pattern: room rates / an hourly rate / at a lower rate / special rates
senses.example: The hotel offers a special [[rate]] for students who stay more than three nights.
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店為住宿超過三晚的學生提供特別優惠的價格。

gsat.sentence: Teens [[rated]] Hilfiger jeans as their number one brand in a survey in 2000.
Calls within an area code and often a small group of neighboring area codes are normally charged at a lower [[rate]] than outside the area code.

senses.en: to follow and watch someone closely, often secretly
senses.pattern: shadow a suspect / shadow someone closely / be shadowed by detectives
senses.example: Two detectives [[shadowed]] the suspect for a week, noting everyone he met and every place he visited.
senses.example_zh: 兩名警探跟蹤嫌犯一星期，記下他見過的每個人和去過的每個地方。

senses.en: a very small amount of something, especially doubt
senses.pattern: beyond a shadow of a doubt / without a shadow of a doubt / not a shadow of doubt
senses.example: The video proved beyond a [[shadow]] of a doubt that the driver had run the red light.
senses.example_zh: 這段影片證明駕駛確實闖了紅燈，沒有一絲懷疑的餘地。

senses.en: a share or part of something
senses.pattern: a slice of the market / a slice of the profits / a large slice of the budget
senses.example: Online shops now take a large [[slice]] of the market once controlled by department stores.
senses.example_zh: 網路商店如今占去了過去由百貨公司掌控的一大部分市場。
senses.note: a slice of life＝生活的片段、寫照

senses.en: reliable; having a strong basis
senses.pattern: solid evidence / a solid foundation / a solid reason / solid support
senses.example: Three years of daily practice gave her a [[solid]] foundation in English grammar and writing.
senses.example_zh: 三年來每天練習，讓她在英文文法和寫作上打下紮實的基礎。

senses.en: continuous; without any break
senses.pattern: three solid hours / for a solid week / two hours solid
senses.example: It rained for three [[solid]] days, and the river flooded the nearby fields.
senses.example_zh: 雨整整下了三天，河水淹沒了附近的田地。

gsat.sentence: This story may sound highly credible, but there seems to be no [[solid]] evidence that it inspired the creation of the treats we know of today as fortune cookies.
This course will provide students with a [[solid]] foundation for research. It is highly recommended for those who plan to go to graduate school.

senses.en: to provide the workers for an organization
senses.pattern: be staffed by volunteers / staff the front desk / fully staffed
senses.example: The new community clinic will be [[staffed]] by two doctors and six experienced nurses.
senses.example_zh: 新的社區診所將配備兩名醫師和六名資深護理師。

senses.en: difficult or unpleasant to deal with
senses.pattern: a sticky situation / a sticky problem / a sticky moment
senses.example: Lending money to close friends can put you in a [[sticky]] situation if they cannot pay.
senses.example_zh: 借錢給好友，萬一對方還不出來，可能會讓你陷入棘手的處境。

senses.en: (of weather or people) hot, damp, and uncomfortable
senses.pattern: hot and sticky / a sticky afternoon / sticky weather / feel sticky
senses.example: It was a hot, [[sticky]] afternoon, and everyone on the crowded bus longed for a cold shower.
senses.example_zh: 那是個炎熱濕黏的午後，擁擠公車上的每個人都渴望沖個冷水澡。

gsat.sentence: The roasting heat and high humidity made me feel hot and [[sticky]], no matter what I did to cool off.

senses.en: to become worse in quality or condition
senses.pattern: grades suffer / quality suffers / sb's health suffers / business suffers
senses.example: If you stay up late playing games every night, your schoolwork will certainly [[suffer]].
senses.example_zh: 如果你每天晚上都熬夜打電動，課業表現一定會變差。

senses.en: to adjust an instrument or engine so it works correctly
senses.pattern: tune a guitar / tune a piano / tune an engine
senses.example: Before every concert, the violinist spends ten minutes carefully [[tuning]] her instrument backstage.
senses.example_zh: 每場音樂會前，這位小提琴家都會在後台花十分鐘仔細替樂器調音。

senses.en: a means of expressing or achieving something
senses.pattern: a vehicle for / serve as a vehicle for / a vehicle of expression
senses.example: Social media has become a powerful [[vehicle]] for spreading both news and rumors.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體已成為傳播新聞與謠言的強大媒介。

senses.en: to move along by turning and changing direction
senses.pattern: weave through traffic / weave in and out of / weave your way through
senses.example: The delivery rider [[weaved]] through the heavy traffic to get the meals there on time.
senses.example_zh: 外送員在擁擠的車陣中迂迴穿行，好把餐點準時送達。

senses.en: to put facts or events together into a story
senses.pattern: weave a story / weave a tale / weave sth into the plot
senses.example: The novelist [[wove]] a moving story from the letters her grandparents wrote during the war.
senses.example_zh: 這位小說家用祖父母在戰時寫的信，編寫出一個動人的故事。

quiz.stem: Although Mia smiled and congratulated the winner, she secretly ______ deep anger toward the judges, who she believed had treated her unfairly.
quiz.explain_zh: harbor＝心懷（情緒）。Mia 表面上恭喜贏家，心裡卻對評審懷著怒氣。

quiz.stem: All first-year students are required to attend a two-day ______ before the semester begins, where they learn about school rules and meet their new classmates.
quiz.explain_zh: orientation＝新生訓練。大一新生開學前須參加兩天的新生訓練。

quiz.stem: For the drama club, the annual school play is more than entertainment; it serves as a ______ for students to express their views on social issues.
quiz.explain_zh: vehicle＝媒介。年度公演不只是娛樂，更是學生表達社會觀點的媒介。

quiz.stem: The lawyer warned her client that without ______ evidence, such as photos or written records, the judge would be unlikely to believe his story.
quiz.explain_zh: solid＝可靠的。沒有照片或書面紀錄等可靠證據，法官不太會相信。

quiz.stem: Scientists are examining the bones found in the cave to ______ how long ago these animals lived in the area.
quiz.explain_zh: determine＝查明、確定。科學家檢驗洞穴中的骨頭，以查明這些動物生存的年代。

quiz.stem: The story of the greedy dog ends with a simple ______: those who always want more often lose what they already have.
quiz.explain_zh: moral＝寓意、教訓。貪心狗的故事寓意是：貪得無厭的人往往失去原有的東西。

quiz.stem: It is a great ______ for me to stand here today and receive this award on behalf of all the volunteers.
quiz.explain_zh: privilege＝榮幸。能代表全體志工上台領獎是莫大的榮幸。

quiz.stem: Scientists warn that plastic waste in the oceans poses a ______ threat to sea animals, many of which die after swallowing it.
quiz.explain_zh: grave＝嚴重的。海洋中的塑膠垃圾對海洋動物構成嚴重的威脅。

quiz.stem: At the technology forum, a ______ of doctors and engineers discussed whether artificial intelligence could safely help diagnose patients.
quiz.explain_zh: panel＝專家小組。論壇上由醫師和工程師組成的小組討論 AI 能否協助診斷。

quiz.stem: The information booth at the night market is ______ by college volunteers who can answer tourists' questions in English, Japanese, and Korean.
quiz.explain_zh: staff＝為…配備人員。夜市服務台由會說多國語言的大學生志工駐守。
